_about: Competitor-mirror ads for Juno. Each ad takes one claim a competitor is paying to run (docs/competitor-ads-2026-10-29.md) and answers it with real footage of Juno doing the thing. Rendered by src/templates/JunoAd.tsx. Times are seconds inside the clip in public/juno-ads/. status: ready = footage exists; planned = needs a take from the rig (scene brief in `scene`). camera: keyframes [clipSec, cx, cy, zoom] with cx, cy as fractions of the clip frame; the view eases to each keyframe over 0.8 s, Screen Studio style. Positioning (Lacy, 2026-10-30): paraphrase the competitor slogan head-on and speak as a peer with the same confidence. Say "your computer", not "your Mac": Windows is coming. Never claim laptop-closed or a cloud computer.
